retired.placement.ruinsPerThousandLand: Density measured against the whole map read as a single grey average, and at 5/1000 land the nearest site to a capital was 7-16 hexes away — too sparse for a scout to find anything in the opening. Replaced by placement.sitesPerContinent, dealt per carved continent (carveContinents, the same regions the luxury deal uses) exactly as villagesPerThousandLand was.
retired.placement.villagesPerThousandLand: See placement.ruinsPerThousandLand — folded into placement.sitesPerContinent and split by placement.ruinShare.

grainCache.name: Grain cache
grainCache.flavor: Jars sunk in cool earth, sealed against a winter nobody survived.

masonsHoard.name: Masons' hoard
masonsHoard.flavor: Dressed stone, stacked and numbered, for a wall never raised.

starTablets.name: Star tablets
starTablets.flavor: Clay ruled into a sky, and the sky has not moved since.

forgottenHymns.name: Forgotten hymns
forgottenHymns.flavor: The words are gone; the shape of the singing is not.

relicsOfTheOldFaith.name: Relics of the old faith
relicsOfTheOldFaith.flavor: Somebody knelt here for a long time, and wore the stone.

aGuideOffersService.name: A guide offers service
aGuideOffersService.flavor: She knows the passes, and asks only to be going somewhere.

laborersJoinYou.name: Laborers join you
laborersJoinYou.flavor: A dozen hands, and the tools they were holding when they came.

tradersHoard.name: Traders' hoard
tradersHoard.flavor: A caravan's whole season, buried the night before it was needed.
